text:
GENERATE BURST CS-mist-2_2 — MIST PASS on painted cliffside chunk 2_2 (Matt: 'some of the underside of some of the cliffs are transparent'; R-C3-60). task_id "CS-mist-2_2".

IMAGE 1 is a finished hand-painted 2D game-level chunk (1536×1024): sunlit cliff-top grass/dirt, rocky rims, and tall rock CLIFF FACES that drop toward the viewer into a canyon; PURE GREEN #00ff00 = empty void (the distant valley is drawn separately behind it in the game). Its overlap strips with neighbouring chunks that were ALREADY given this mist pass (top 256 rows and/or left 256 columns where they exist) must stay as they are and be continued seamlessly.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536×1024 image in which: the lower part of EVERY cliff face disappears into a thick, OPAQUE bank of billowing valley mist — the rock grows hazier going down and is swallowed by the mist, so NO bottom edge of rock is ever visible. The mist bank is lit by the sunset: soft lavender and dusky violet in shadow, warm rose-peach where the light catches the billow tops, with painted cloud forms (not a flat colour, not a gradient). Its UNDERSIDE is a soft, rounded, cloud-like edge against the flat green; wisps may drift a little out over the green. Keep the upper cliff faces, rims, grass, dirt, bridge and everything above the mist EXACTLY as painted; every green pixel not covered by mist stays flat pure #00ff00.
REGISTER: the same hand-drawn painted 2D style as IMAGE 1 (tapered contours, painted planes, bold jewel tones). No characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if rock above the mist was repainted differently, a strip was altered, a rock bottom edge is still visible, or the green was painted over away from the mist — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/mist_2_2.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-mist-2_2"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the painted chunk to EDIT
